Name: Apple Orchard Math
Overview: Apple Orchard Math is an educational game which challenges the player's mathematical skills. The player can choose challenges specific to addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, as well as set the lowest and highest numbers (between 12 and 99) that they wish to be tested on. In each challenge, the player is presented with an incomplete mathematical expression (for example "_ + _ = 10") and is given a selection of numbers to use to complete the expression. Each correct answer places one apple on an apple tree in the titular orchard. Once 10 apples have been placed on the tree, the game ends and the player receives a score based on their performance.
